text:
Nora L.: Proposal: set up a small "Gratitude Sticker Booth" for two days next week to drive micro-recognition and make it fun. People can grab stickers and drop a short nomination card in a box for instant spot-awards. Need volunteers, sticker counts, and a plan for contractor payouts.

Sam T.: I'm in for volunteer shifts. What are hours?

Nora L.: Target 11:30-2:00 Tue & Wed (lunch traffic). Two volunteers per shift (11:30-12:30, 12:30-13:30). HQ pilot only (we'll mirror in SF/LON later).

Vikram P.: I'll coordinate the spot-award routing. Quick policy reminder: awards < $100 auto-approve; > $100 needs manager sign-off. HR Ops Bot, confirm?

HR Ops Bot: Confirmed. Contractors eligible up to $75 as non-cash. Use project=Culture, code=STKR-POP for expenses. For contractors, tag vendor-pay with STKR-CTOR.

Design Ops: We can produce 4 sticker designs + 2 bilingual micro-cards (EN/ES). How many stickers?

Nora L.: Headcount ~140. Print 250 stickers to be safe. 200 cards. Budget estimate $120 printing + $80 gift-cards. Finance Ops ok?

Finance Ops: Approved provisional spend. Please attach receipts and include project code STKR-POP on expense.

Sam T.: Volunteers: I'll take Tue 11:30 and Wed 12:30. @Maya can you do Tue 12:30?

Maya R.: Yes I can. Also can help with anonymous card scanning (we'll transcribe nominations into the recognition sheet).

Facilities Bot: Can reserve a small table near reception. Trolley and trash bin reserved. Please ensure clear ADA path.

Nora L.: Accessibility: make a large-print card and have a marker for handwritten notes. Also include a QR code on cards for folks to nominate digitally.

Design Ops: High-contrast alternate card and large-print produced. I'll send final art by Mon noon.

Vikram P.: For spot awards, I'll triage nominations Wed afternoon, flag manager approvals needed, and route gift-cards. Who can pick up physical cards for remote winners?

Nora L.: Maya can pack remote kits; Sam will drop at mailroom Wed 3pm. Maya?

Maya R.: Confirmed. I'll also add consent checkbox on the digital form for photos.

Sam T.: Photographer? Marketing wants a couple of shots for socials; will they be ok with candid style?

Design Ops: Marketing Ops prefers candid but please capture without identifying sensitive info. Also get waiver on the sign-in clipboard.

Nora L.: Logistics timeline:

```text
Mon 12:00 - final art and print order placed
Tue 9:30 - table set & supplies delivered (Facilities)
Tue 11:30-13:30 - Booth day 1 (Sam + volunteer)
Wed 11:30-13:30 - Booth day 2 (Maya + Sam)
Wed 15:00 - triage nominations + schedule payouts (Vikram)
Within 7 days - expense submit (project=Culture, code=STKR-POP)
```

Finance Ops: Reminder - collect receipts and attach to /expense. Use gift-card vendor for contractors.

Nora L.: Final ask: need one more volunteer Wed 11:30 and someone to take quick notes on the nomination themes. Any takers?

Vikram P.: I can do Wed 11:30 and take notes.

Nora L.: Perfect. I'll post a short event blurb in #general Mon morning and link the volunteer signup sheet. Thanks all! :sparkles:
